test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only one person sits between T and R. Only one person sits between R and U. Only two people sit between U and Q. S sits to the immediate left of T. Who sits second to the left of P?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Only one person sits between T and R.

2) Only one person sits between R and U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/830ad24e2a550651a9af46f8ccdc29a58e457dfdb8b37c6a3e7d973a4678aa49.png] 

3) Only two people sit between U and Q.
